children: Daniel Ölander Heikkilä, primary insider and deputy employee-elected board member in Protector Forsikring ASA, has today 2 September 2026 acquired 129 shares in Protector Forsikring ASA at a price of NOK 470.5705 per share.
Following this transaction, Mr. Heikkilä and his related parties holds 2,050 shares in Protector Forsikring ASA.
This information is subject to the disclosure requirements in MAR (regulation EU) No. 596/2014 on market abuse) as implemented in Norway in accordance with section 3-1 of the Securities Trading Act.

title: Mandatory notification of trade - Protector Forsikring ASA
